title: Full History Evidence Intake

1_DRY_HARNESS.summary: Early DRY/Harness phase established foundational principles: live evidence, negative controls, fail-closed gates, verifier anti-overfitting, reject preclassified-only evidence, run state, integration ledger, evidence sanitizer. Core insight: Factory's purpose is to improve Codex workflow through defect evidence, NOT to build test applications.

2_AGENT_MULTI_AGENT.summary: AGENT-9/AGENT-9-P3 froze strategies: multi-agent NOT default, v0.5 BLOCKED, Native Build Pro conditional only, single success does not prove Factory superiority. BUILD-7/BUILD-8/PRO-2 demonstrated NBP usable but still conditional.

3_DIAGNOSTIC_PACK.summary: Diagnostic Pack can discover real issues but user corrected: diagnosis is NOT the mainline. Positioned as support gate, not Codex Factory mainline. Cannot mistake audit results for build capability.

4_BUILD_MAINLINE.summary: BUILD-0 reset the mainline: Build engine is mainline, Diagnostic is gate. Build Lite = default. Native Build Pro = conditional. Build Mode, External Memory, Context Packet, Package QA Gate gradually formed a coherent system.

5_CONTEXT_SPACE.summary: User proposed 'reservoir' model: cannot expand model memory capacity, but can filter high-quality information into context pool. CONTEXT-SPACE-0 through P7 established: External Conversation Space, SQLite index, Query v2, Snapshot Packs, Attach Packet v3, Direction Guard v3, Phase Close Context Update, True fresh-window validation. P7 proved new windows can mount mainline via external conversation space only.

6_PACKAGE_QA_GATE.summary: BOOT-001 (no Factory Bootstrap trigger on complex tasks) fixed via Bootstrap Gate. QA-001 (Factory-generated packages need final QA) fixed via Package QA Gate, integrated into staging P2. Package QA Gate is final delivery hygiene check, not product correctness proof.

7_REALWORLD_1.summary: Online Bookstore validated Build Lite can safely take over real project working copies. Proved working-copy isolation, Context Packet, Diagnostic Gate, targeted repair all effective. 25/25 verifier PASS.

8_REALWORLD_2.summary: TCM Django production project with real domain/server/deploy traces/production key risks. Intake discovered sensitive config and deployment risks. R1 correction: finding issues does NOT prove Factory smarter than vanilla Codex. P1-P5: working-copy safe, security hardened, tests 21/2/0, original untouched, v0.5 blocked.

cross_thread_patterns: Factory superiority over vanilla Codex: NOT PROVEN across all threads
Build Lite default: VALIDATED by REALWORLD-1 + REALWORLD-2
Working-copy isolation: VALIDATED by both realworld phases
Security/Deploy Gate: NECESSARY for real deployed projects
Context Space: PROVEN effective for long-horizon continuity
Negative controls + verifier: PROVEN anti-overfitting mechanism
No cloud without local proof: MAINTAINED throughout
